name: Hyderabad Tech Week
heading: Hyderabad
description: A gathering for the people building technology in Hyderabad. By Curious Commons.
intro: For the people building technology, and the people they haven’t met yet.
aboutTitle: A reason to get in the same room.
about: Hyderabad has people building across software, research, enterprise and creative work. We’re bringing some of those conversations together, with room to share a project, ask a useful question and meet a future collaborator.

formats.title: Show the work
formats.text: Demos and practical conversations about the choices behind a product, a system or a piece of research.

formats.title: Learn alongside someone
formats.text: Working sessions where people can try an idea, compare approaches and ask the questions that don’t fit in a slide deck.

formats.title: Make time to meet
formats.text: Gatherings for people across teams and communities to talk, exchange notes and stay in touch.

invitation: Make a place for your people.
invitationText: Have a session idea, a space, or a community you would like to bring together? We’d like to hear from you.

art.alt: An illustration of Hyderabad’s skyline and people gathering across the city.

faq.question: When is the first edition?
faq.answer: Dates and venues have not been announced. Follow the calendar for updates as the programme takes shape.

faq.question: Can I host a session?
faq.answer: Yes. Write to hello@curiouscommons.com with your idea, who it is for, and what you would need to run it. We will discuss the fit before anything is announced.

faq.question: How will registration work?
faq.answer: Confirmed events will have their own listings and entry requirements. Following the calendar is an update subscription, not an event ticket.
